fundednext.verdictText: FundedNext is a Dubai-based CFD prop firm selling Stellar 2-step and 1-step evaluations from $59.99 (6K) to $1,099.99 (200K), plus a cheaper Stellar Lite line from $32.99 and instant-funding accounts from $59. Funded traders start at an 80% profit split (up to 95% via paid add-on) and the flagship Stellar 2-step uses a static 10% maximum drawdown with a 5% daily limit and no consistency rule. The firm advertises a 24-hour payout guarantee backed by a $1,000 penalty, with an average processing time it reports at around 40 hours or less. News trading is not restricted in its public terms. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

the-5-ers.verdictText: The5ers is one of the longer-standing CFD prop firms, best known for its High Stakes 2-step program priced from $39 (5K) to $495 (100K) with a static 10% maximum loss and 5% daily limit. High Stakes traders start on an 80% profit split that can scale to 100%, with a minimum of 3 profitable days and payouts every 14 days via Rise, crypto, or bank transfer. Trading in a 2-minute window around high-impact news is not allowed on High Stakes accounts. The firm also runs Hyper Growth instant-funding and Bootcamp programs with different terms. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

brightfunded.verdictText: BrightFunded is a 2-step-only CFD prop firm with challenges priced in euros from €55 (5K) to €975 (200K), using a static 10% maximum drawdown, 5% daily limit, and 8%/5% phase targets. Funded traders start on an 80% profit split, rising to 90% and then 100% through scale-ups every four months, and there is no consistency rule at any stage. Payouts run bi-weekly by default (weekly via a paid add-on) in USDT or bank transfer, with a 24-hour processing guarantee and the challenge fee refunded on the first payout. Trading is blocked in a 10-minute window around high-impact news. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

e8-markets.verdictText: E8 Markets is a US-founded prop firm whose current lineup centers on the customizable E8 One 1-step evaluation ($5K to $500K, with selectable drawdown from 4% to 14% and profit split of 80%, 90%, or 100%) alongside the E8 Signature 2-step at $130 (50K), $260 (100K), and $390 (150K). Because fees scale with the chosen risk parameters, E8 One pricing varies per configuration; drawdown is trailing with an end-of-day option as the default characterization. The base profit split is 80% with paid upgrades to 90-100%, payouts run every 14 days with the first available after 8 days, and processing is reported at 1-2 days. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

hola-prime.verdictText: Hola Prime, launched in 2024, sells 1-step, 2-step, and instant (Direct) accounts from $2K to $300K, with 2-Step Prime challenges priced from $39 (5K) to $939 (200K). Its headline feature is payout speed: withdrawals are processed within one hour via RiseWorks, crypto, or bank transfer, and the profit split depends on the chosen payout cycle - 65% weekly, 80% bi-weekly, or 95% monthly. Prime challenge accounts use static drawdowns, allow news trading and EAs, and require 3 minimum trading days per phase, while Direct instant accounts use trailing drawdowns with a 20% consistency rule. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

crypto-fund-trader.verdictText: Crypto Fund Trader is a Spain-based, crypto-first prop firm (founded 2022) offering two-phase evaluations from $80 (5K) to $1,798 (200K) and cheaper one-phase accounts from $40, with direct Bybit integration as its standout feature. Two-phase accounts target 8% then 5% with a static 10% maximum loss and 5% daily limit; one-phase accounts use a tighter 6% overall drawdown, and the live profit split on one-phase accounts scales from 50% up to 90% by size. News trading and EAs are allowed and there are no minimum trading days on the main challenges. Note that reviewers report a 2024 FINMA warning and discretionary payout language in its terms, which warrants caution. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

goat-funded-trader.verdictText: Goat Funded Trader (founded 2023, Hong Kong) runs one of the broadest challenge menus in the space - 1-step, 2-step in GOAT/Standard/Pro variants, 3-step, and instant accounts from $5K to $400K - with 2-Step GOAT pricing from $22 (5K) to $448 (200K). The base profit split is 80% with paid upgrades toward 100%, payouts run bi-weekly via Rise, crypto, or Skrill, and challenge drawdowns are static. Funded accounts carry a 15% best-day consistency rule (20% on Instant Pro) and profit made within 5 minutes of high-impact news is capped at 1%. Reviewers also flag payout caps on early withdrawals and strict limits on third-party EAs, so read the funded-account terms closely. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

atmos-funded.verdictText: Atmos Funded offers 1-step, 2-step, 1-step Plus, and instant accounts from $5K to $200K, with full 1-Step Standard pricing from $63 (5K) to $1,020 (200K). Drawdown handling is mixed: the 1-step uses a 6% trailing maximum with a 3% daily limit, while the 2-step uses a static 10% maximum with 5% daily. Profit split runs 80-90%, payouts are bi-weekly with 2-5 business days of processing via bank wire, crypto, or a Taurex account transfer, and 3 minimum trading days apply to evaluations. News trading is permitted during challenges but restricted within 2 minutes of high-impact events on funded accounts. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

alpha-capital-group.verdictText: Alpha Capital Group is a UK-based prop firm whose flagship Alpha Pro 2-step evaluation runs $97 (10K) to $997 (200K), using a static 10% maximum drawdown with a 5% balance-based daily limit and 10%/5% phase targets. It also sells Alpha One (1-step, 6% trailing), Alpha Swing (weekend holding permitted), and Alpha Three (3-step) variants. The performance split is 80% (90% via paid add-on), payouts are bi-weekly or on-demand via Rise, Wise, or bank transfer, and on-demand withdrawals require a 40% best-day rule plus at least 2% profit. News trading is restricted in 2-5 minute windows on funded accounts and 3 minimum trading days apply per phase. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

aquafunded.verdictText: AquaFunded sells 1-step and 2-step evaluations up to $200K, with 2-step pricing from $99 (10K) to $999 (200K) and an 8%/5% two-phase target structure. Its 2-Step Standard accounts use static drawdowns (5% daily, 8% maximum from starting balance), while the 2-Step Pro variant applies trailing logic with a 10% maximum. The standard profit split is 90% with an optional 100% upgrade, and payouts run every 14 days with roughly 48-hour processing. Fee refunds are tied to multiple compliant payouts rather than the first one, and some funded pathways carry consistency requirements, so check the plan-specific terms. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

trade-the-pool.verdictText: Trade The Pool is the rare prop firm focused on real US stocks and ETFs (12,000+ symbols via its trading environment) rather than CFDs, with Day Trade evaluations from $47 (5K buying power) to $1,475 (200K) and separate Swing programs from $69. Drawdowns are static - roughly 2-3% daily and 4% max on Day Trade, 7% max on Swing - and the profit split is 70% (with day-trade/swing payout splits of 70/30 and 50/50 respectively). Payouts run every 14 days for day-trading accounts (weekly for swing) via Rise or crypto, with a $300 minimum. News trading is fully allowed, but EAs and automated trading are strictly prohibited. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

blue-guardian.verdictText: Blue Guardian offers instant, 1-step, 2-step, and 3-step accounts from $5K to $400K, with 2-Step Standard pricing from $112 (10K) to $1,162 (200K) and a cheaper Pro line from $79. Its maximum drawdown is a 6% trailing model that locks in at the starting balance (plus a 1% buffer) once the account gains 6% - effectively a hybrid - alongside a roughly 4% daily limit, and consistency rules of 15-25% apply depending on the plan. The profit split starts at 80% rising to 90%, and payouts are bi-weekly by default with a 24-hour processing guarantee that pays 100% of profits if missed. Reviewers caution that terms vary considerably across its many account models, including the Guardian Shield breach rule, so verify the plan-specific rules before buying. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

maven-trading.verdictText: Maven Trading is one of the cheapest entry points in the funded-account market, with challenges from $15 (2K 3-step) up to $495 (100K 1-step) across 1-step, 2-step, 3-step, instant, and mini programs spanning $2K to $100K. The flagship 2-step uses a static 8% maximum loss with a 4% daily limit and 8%/5% targets, funded traders keep 80% (70% on instant, 75% on mini), and 3 minimum trading days apply. Payouts run bi-weekly with a $50 minimum via bank wire or crypto, news trading is unrestricted, and standard algorithmic strategies are allowed while HFT and latency arbitrage are banned. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]

fundedelite.verdictText: FundedElite offers 1-step, 2-step, Lite, and instant accounts from $5K to $300K, with 2-step pricing from $89 (7K) to $1,499 (300K) and budget Lite 2-step entries from $19; note that fees vary with the leverage and parameter options chosen at checkout. Standard challenges use static drawdowns (5% daily, 8-10% maximum) with an 80% profit split that can reach 95%, while instant accounts run a trailing equity drawdown at a 70% base split. Payouts are bi-weekly (roughly every 14-21 days) via Rise or crypto, 3 minimum trading days apply, and news trading is permitted within the firm's strategy rules. [Draft verdict — pending editorial review.]
